notice: The CVSP Lab works on computer vision, multimodal AI, 3D/4D spatial intelligence, and visual intelligence for robots.
We are always recruiting undergraduate research interns, graduate students, and postdoctoral researchers. Please contact us by email before you apply.
If you are interested, please send a short introduction, your research interests, and your transcript or CV to kbkong@pusan.ac.kr.
intro: The Computer Vision & Signal Processing Lab, led by Professor Kyeongbo Kong at Pusan National University, is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and collaborative research environment. We are looking for dedicated researchers to join our team. Here are some key principles of our lab:
principles: CVSP promotes a respectful and inclusive lab culture.
CVSP values collaboration over competition for mutual growth.
Flexible working hours and the freedom to choose your research location.
offer: We offer various opportunities to join the lab, which includes internships, graduate positions, and postdoctoral appointments. Below are the details on how to apply based on your interest and current status.

tracks.label: Undergraduate
tracks.title: Internships
role: Study fundamental deep learning and computer vision problems and acquire background knowledge.
Assist in writing and presenting papers at domestic and international conferences.
Optionally participate in a research project within the lab.
apply: Email a brief description of your research interests in computer vision to kbkong@pusan.ac.kr.
If positions are available, a short interview will be scheduled.
recommended: Basic mathematics (e.g., probability & statistics, linear algebra).

tracks.label: Graduate
tracks.title: Graduate Students
tracks.notice: Contact the lab before applying to the Electrical & Electronics Engineering Graduate School at Pusan National University. It is highly recommended to apply for an internship before applying to the graduate program.
apply: Email your academic transcript, CV, and research interests in computer vision to kbkong@pusan.ac.kr.
A preliminary interview with the professor will be scheduled before you officially apply to the graduate school.
Apply to the Electrical & Electronics Engineering Graduate School at Pusan National University.
Note: Besides the department-level interview, there will be an independent lab-level interview.
recommended: A first-class Bachelor’s degree in electrical & electronics engineering, computer science engineering, or a related field (e.g., industrial engineering, semiconductor engineering, mechanical engineering, mathematics).
Basic mathematics (e.g., probability & statistics, linear algebra).
Preferable: Experience in deep learning through projects or publications.

tracks.label: Researcher
tracks.title: Researchers and Postdocs
apply: Email your academic transcript, CV, and research interests in computer vision to kbkong@pusan.ac.kr.
The process will be similar to that of graduate student applications, which includes a preliminary interview and potential further steps.
